summary: Iteration 71: Validated InFlow's own direct Zoho CRM OAuth (Multi-DC). Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (test_zoho_direct_oauth_iter71.py) covering status/start/callback error flows (bogus/missing/reused state, non-allowlisted accounts-server, access_denied), auth gating (401 on unauthenticated), /sync and /disconnect 404 when not connected, Scalekit no longer offers Zoho (connectors == quickbooks+stripe; /scalekit/zoho/start -> 404), /business/platforms has no 'zoho' and POST /business/connect/zoho -> 404, workspace/outreach/intent graceful 4xx with no 500, and a FAKE Zoho OAuth connection end-to-end (status connected, sync 400 with friendly 'invalid_code', workspace targets readable error, workspace execute returns 422/failed never 500, disconnect 200 removes row and 404 on second call). Frontend: Login via /auth, /connect-business shows scalekit-section with 3 cards (quickbooks, stripe, zoho). Zoho card has subtitle 'Direct sign-in · all Zoho regions', 'Two-way sync' badge (scalekit-twoway-zoho), button 'Connect Zoho CRM' (scalekit-connect-zoho). scalekit-finalize-zoho correctly ABSENT; for quickbooks/stripe already connected so finalize link also absent (shown only when not connected on non-direct cards). Toast handling verified: /connect-business?zoho_error=Test+message -> error toast present; ?zoho=connected&records=3 -> success toast 'imported 3 deals' present. Clicking scalekit-connect-zoho navigates to accounts.zoho.com with correct client_id, redirect_uri, 8 scopes, access_type=offline, prompt=consent, state. Caveat: real sign-in not attempted (preview redirect URI not yet registered in Zoho console — expected).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (critical, by testing agent): In server.py, api_router.include_router(integrations_router) was registered BEFORE zoho_router. The generic '/integrations/{integration_id}/disconnect' handler in routes/integrations.py (which only looks at db.integrations) was shadowing '/integrations/zoho/disconnect' (which must look at db.business_connections). This caused Zoho disconnect to ALWAYS return 404 'Integration not found or not connected' even when a Zoho connection existed, leaving stale rows and encrypted refresh tokens in db.business_connections forever. Reordered to include zoho_router + scalekit_router BEFORE integrations_router. Please keep that ordering invariant (or make the generic integrations route exclude 'zoho'/'scalekit' explicitly).

zoho_integration.py: refresh token is decrypted/stored unchanged on first callback, but Zoho rotates refresh tokens occasionally — consider updating refresh_token_encrypted on refresh if tok.get('refresh_token') is returned.

zoho_integration.py callback: on success it stores the connection THEN calls import_deals which can raise and gets swallowed to records=0; good — but logged only at warning. Consider surfacing the import-failure reason to the UI via zoho_error alongside connected=true, or add a 'last_sync_error' field.

rca of the issue: Zoho disconnect returning 404 even when connected — root cause: FastAPI include_router ordering. Both '/integrations/{integration_id}/disconnect' (generic in integrations.py) and '/integrations/zoho/disconnect' (specific in zoho_integration.py) match the path. Whichever router is included first wins. integrations_router was included first in server.py, shadowing the Zoho route. Mitigation: reorder include_router so zoho_router and scalekit_router come before integrations_router. Verified test_fake_disconnect_removes_row now passes.
